{{Top|leg}}
'''Inspector Auditor''' was a position within the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]]. They were responsible for visiting companies that were members of the Guild and auditing their finances to ensure they were paying their proper dues. Inspector Auditors travelled extensively and were assigned to specific regions. [[Annora Calandra]] held the position of Inspector Auditor, with authority over companies in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="LE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
